constitutional_basis: Article XXXII — before every major conclusion, state the strongest alternative explanation. Expected metrics force us to commit to a prediction BEFORE the lab reports back.

predictions_for_bench_validation.honest_note: Strict INV-1 (<=20) expected to be violated in some seeds. Graceful-degradation ceiling 22 expected to hold.
Catastrophic failure expected. System enters fail-safe (all valves open). Patient-equivalent requires emergency revision. Same outcome as current standard of care.

what_constitutes_refutation_of_our_claim: If bench P_ICP peak > 25 mmHg in mild scenario — claim of graceful degradation is FALSE
If any INV-2 violation in any scenario — claim of dual-invariant policy is FALSE
If predictor lead time < 15 min in mild scenario — predictor is too slow
If system does not survive 24h in mild/adversarial — design is not viable
what_constitutes_corroboration: All pre-registered predictions matched within stated tolerance across 5 seeds per scenario.
